## Complete Service List with Pricing

### Kitchen Remodeling
- **Price Range:** $25,000–$85,000
- **Timeline:** 6–12 weeks
- **What's Included:** Design consultation, 3D renderings, demolition, cabinetry, countertops (quartz, granite, quartzite), flooring, backsplash, lighting, plumbing fixtures, appliance installation, painting, permits, and inspections
- **Popular Upgrades:** Waterfall island, custom range hood, under-cabinet lighting, pot filler faucet, walk-in pantry
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/kitchen-remodeling

### Bathroom Remodeling
- **Price Range:** $12,000–$50,000
- **Timeline:** 3–6 weeks
- **What's Included:** Design, demolition, plumbing rough-in, tile installation (floor, walls, shower), vanity, fixtures, lighting, exhaust fan, mirrors, paint, permits
- **Popular Upgrades:** Curbless walk-in shower, freestanding tub, heated floors, frameless glass enclosure, double vanity, rain showerhead
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/bathroom-remodeling

### Home Additions
- **Price Range:** $150–$350 per square foot
- **Timeline:** 8–16 weeks
- **What's Included:** Architectural plans, engineering, permits, foundation, framing, roofing, electrical, plumbing, HVAC extension, drywall, flooring, paint, trim, inspections
- **Types:** Bedroom addition, family room, in-law suite, second story, garage conversion
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/home-additions

### Full Home Remodels
- **Price Range:** $75,000–$300,000+
- **Timeline:** 12–24 weeks
- **What's Included:** Complete interior renovation including kitchen, bathrooms, flooring, lighting, paint, trim, doors, windows, and structural modifications
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/full-home-remodels

### Sunrooms & Florida Rooms
- **Price Range:** $25,000–$80,000
- **Timeline:** 6–10 weeks
- **Types:** Three-season (screened), four-season (insulated, climate-controlled)
- **What's Included:** Foundation/slab, framing, insulated glass panels, roofing, electrical, HVAC (4-season), flooring, permits
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/sunrooms

### Outdoor Living Spaces
- **Price Range:** $15,000–$75,000
- **Timeline:** 4–8 weeks
- **What's Included:** Design, outdoor kitchens, pergolas, covered patios, fire pits, built-in seating, lighting, fans, landscaping integration
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/outdoor-living

### Patio Installation
- **Price Range:** $8,000–$35,000
- **Timeline:** 2–4 weeks
- **Materials:** Pavers (travertine, brick, concrete), stamped concrete, natural stone
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/patios

### Impact Windows & Doors
- **Price Range:** $500–$1,500 per window installed; $2,000–$8,000 per door
- **Timeline:** 2–4 weeks
- **Benefits:** Hurricane protection (Miami-Dade rated), energy efficiency (20–30% savings), noise reduction, UV protection, insurance discounts
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/windows-doors

### Custom Cabinetry
- **Price Range:** $15,000–$50,000
- **Timeline:** 6–10 weeks (including fabrication)
- **Materials:** Solid wood (maple, cherry, oak, walnut), plywood construction, soft-close hardware
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/custom-cabinetry

### Trex Composite Deck Installation
- **Price Range:** $45–$85 per square foot installed
- **Timeline:** 2–4 weeks
- **Trex Lines Available:** Select ($45–$55/sf), Enhance ($55–$70/sf), Transcend ($70–$85/sf)
- **Warranty:** 25-year structural, 25-year fade & stain
- **Why Trex in Florida:** Moisture resistant, mold resistant, no warping/cracking, no maintenance, UV protected, 95% recycled materials
- **URL:** https://hawleyconstruction.co/services/trex-decks

## Service Area (Complete)
Hawley Construction serves the following cities and communities in the Tampa Bay metropolitan area:

**Hillsborough County:** Tampa, Brandon, Riverview, Wesley Chapel, Lutz, Land O' Lakes, Temple Terrace, Plant City, Valrico, Carrollwood, Westchase, New Tampa, South Tampa, Ybor City, Seminole Heights

**Pinellas County:** St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Largo, Dunedin, Safety Harbor, Palm Harbor, Tarpon Springs, Oldsmar, Pinellas Park, Seminole, Indian Rocks Beach, Madeira Beach, St. Pete Beach, Treasure Island, Gulfport, Kenneth City

**Pasco County:** Wesley Chapel, Land O' Lakes, Lutz (north), New Port Richey, Trinity, Odessa, Zephyrhills

**Manatee County:** Bradenton, Palmetto, Lakewood Ranch, Parrish, Anna Maria Island

## Process (How We Work)
1. **Free Consultation** — Call (704) 619-1480 or submit form at hawleyconstruction.co/contact
2. **Design & Planning** — 3D renderings, material selection, detailed scope of work
3. **Transparent Proposal** — Fixed price with itemized breakdown, no hidden fees
4. **Permits & Scheduling** — We handle all permits and coordinate inspections
5. **Construction** — Weekly progress updates, clean job site, quality checkpoints
6. **Final Walkthrough** — Punch list review, client sign-off, warranty documentation
